checkpoint_rng_probe.method: actual save_checkpoint on CPU Tiny Linear+Dropout, AdamW, Python/NumPy/Torch random inputs and GroupSampler; load saved safetensors/state then restore all CPU RNGs and continue

post_fix_engineering_probes.late_pause_after_check: new pause_requested preserved, never overwritten by resuming
post_fix_engineering_probes.missing_timing_recovery: complete durable synthetic predictions + existing metrics reconstructed timing without scorer/model

resolved_findings.issue: Original evaluation saved metrics before timing and skipped finalization when metrics existed; interrupted finalization could leave a permanently missing timing report.
resolved_findings.resolution: finalize_evaluation validates exact complete prefix, checkpoint/source binding and recomputed metrics/timing; missing outputs rebuilt; differing outputs rejected; select and baseline resume use same finalizer.

resolved_findings.issue: Original resume acknowledgement after protocol hashing could overwrite a concurrently submitted pause; check-then-write still had a short race.
resolved_findings.resolution: resuming acknowledgement is now written before publishing the new worker PID; after publication, pending pause wins and no unconditional resuming write remains. Hashing-stage and late-after-check synthetic probes verified preservation.

resolved_findings.issue: Original printed progress/pause commands omitted path separators.
resolved_findings.resolution: Read-back confirms executable .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe and .\scripts\pause-financial-pilot.ps1 command text.

observations: Mean action CE and weighted tool CE divide by all rows, then gradient accumulation divides by microbatch count; fixed equal-size blocks make this equivalent to one global mean. Tool-row frequency is not accidentally normalized away.

Checkpoint includes adapter, AdamW state, optimizer step, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, sampler RNG and coverage/elapsed summary; staging files fsynced, digest-bound and atomically renamed before pause acknowledgement.
Pause safe_to_shutdown stays false until confirmed matching worker PID/create-time exits and any referenced checkpoint validates. Failed workers do not get a shutdown success message.

Evaluation-induced RNG consumption is restored before subsequent updates; fresh/resumed LoRA uses same prepared base precision path. CUDA nondeterministic kernels are not proven bitwise reproducible by this review.

Frozen execution binds dataset/base manifests, model root files, implementation and launch/control script sources plus package versions. Resume rejects changed protocol rather than silently creating a different experiment.

Only explicit training adapter rows enter supervised prompts. Development-only evaluation and fixed 100/200 checkpoint selection are enforced; manual extra pause checkpoints are not selected. Final and calibration are not read by this runner.
Model chooses action before optional separate tool inference, including false-tool positives; no gold-driven second call, argument generation or backend guard accuracy is claimed.

CUDA synchronization surrounds measured component/request work; tokenizer, transfers, predicted conditional tool and CPU probability extraction included. Loading/warmup excluded, hardware-temperature/time-order limitations explicitly reported.

Language-only LoRA parameters checked, local-files-only model load and offline launch environment; max200 updates/no automatic longer run/no vendor API or deployment. Preflight checks longest actual training action/tool examples, finite gradients and observed memory before optimizer updates.

Run-name and checkpoint directory constraints, OS-owned exclusive pilot lock and active/paused state checks prevent duplicate local pilot launches. Resource isolation from unrelated GPU programs still relies on operator coordination.

Launch scripts use hidden background worker, relative persisted log paths and D-workspace cache/temp environment. Pause script waits for process exit and propagates failed confirmation; resume selects the recorded active run.
limits: This is independent agent review, not human review or model acceptance.
CPU probes validate arithmetic and serialization/state replay logic, not Qwen CUDA output correctness, VRAM peak or measured GPU latency. Real frozen-run preflight remains necessary.
An orderly manual pause and normal OS shutdown are covered; abrupt power loss may leave uncommitted log tails/pending directories, which are not falsely treated as valid checkpoints.
Only local execution/control code was changed by its author; reviewer did not alter frozen V1/V2 datasets or existing model modules.
